verdict.rationale: Firstbase's registered-agent page names the filings it handles (annual reports, franchise tax reports, BOI) and says the service covers all 50 states. It also shows a price of $299 per state per year, but never says whether annual-report filing is included in that price or whether state filing fees are extra. missing for 10: explicit statement that annual-report filing is included in the $299, disclosure of whether state government fees are passed through, per-state list of covered filings, independent corroboration of pricing transparency.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the filing service states which filings and states it covers and what it costs before I buy it
